source: NOAA RRFS CONUS prslev+2dfld pressure-level GRIB2 product pair
time_policy: decoded at every valid time and required invariant; the terrain record lives in the 2dfld file, so the 2dfld files are the supplement
member_policy: the operational RRFS deterministic product carries no member identity; REFS derived products are a different capability and cannot initialize a state
input_identity: dynamic file paths and SHA-256 values are owned by gpuwm-mapped-composition-inputs-v1
